question: I'm migrating an STM32F407 LQFP100 board from silicon revision A to revision Z. Does the PDR_ON connection need to change, and can I continue using a 1.7 V supply?

generation.answer: [Page 1] Applications using revision A devices with PDR_ON pin connected to VDD (POR/PDR feature enabled) should connect the former PDR_ON pin to VSS on revision Z devices. [Page 2] The PDR = 1.7 V for reduce temperature range; PDR = 1.8 V for all temperature range. Therefore, you can continue using a 1.7 V supply when migrating from revision A to revision Z.
